name: Raamah
overview: Raamah is a male figure in Scripture identified as the son of Cush. Beyond this unique attribute, no further tribal affiliation or additional notes are provided. His mention is concise, focusing on his genealogical placement within the descendants of Cush.
namesAndTitles: The name Raamah appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:7. No specific meaning or divine origin of the name is indicated in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Raamah is explicitly recorded as the son of Cush. He is also the father of Sheba and Dedan, establishing his role within a direct familial line. Scripture does not provide other family relationships beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Raamah's significance lies primarily in his genealogical position within the descendants of Cush, as recorded in Genesis 10:7. This placement highlights the continuation of the lineage from Cush, an important figure in the biblical account of nations. Through Raamah, the line extends to Sheba and Dedan, who are also noted in Scripture, indicating the ongoing development of peoples from this ancestry.
